name: Green Tavern
description: Green Tavern is a lively karaoke venue known for its friendly atmosphere and diverse crowd. It offers a welcoming environment with a relaxed vibe, making it a great spot for both casual singing nights and private gatherings. The venue features a good selection of music, friendly staff, and a cozy setting that encourages everyone to join in the fun. Whether you're there for karaoke or just to unwind with friends, Green Tavern provides a memorable experience with quality food and drinks to complement your night.
